ns2:course.label: Physical Chemistry Seminar
ns2:course.description: Required of all graduate students whose major is physical chemistry. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Chemistry or Chemical Physics major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: To be taken by physical chemistry graduate students during any semester. A seminar will be presented to fulfill a Ph.D. requirement.
